prompt:
VISUAL WORLD (identical across all three comps): a premium, minimal, thoughtful wedding-planning website in the spirit of YourDay and Loverly. Warm ivory page ground (#FBF8F3). Deep wine accent (#5E1F33) for the logo mark, primary buttons and small highlights. Soft pastel section washes used sparingly: blush (#F4E4E1) and sage (#E4EAE0). Headlines in a refined, high-contrast editorial serif with one elegant italic accent word; body and UI text in a clean, quiet sans-serif, generous line height. Pill-shaped buttons: primary filled wine with ivory text, secondary thin wine outline. Hairline dividers, very generous whitespace, soft diffused shadows, rounded 16px cards. Calm, romantic, uncluttered; no gradients, no neon, no dark mode, no emoji, no stock icons grid, no sponsor logos, no fake testimonials, no statistics.
Brand: the logo is the word "PlusOne" set in the serif, with "One" in italic wine. Tagline headline text exactly: "Your AI copilot for the perfect wedding."
Crisp, legible, pixel-perfect website UI screenshot, 16:9 desktop viewport 1440x900, flat front-on view, no browser frame, no device mockup, no perspective.
A desktop landing page hero, composition A "the app is the hero", layout top to bottom:
1) Top navigation bar, thin: "PlusOne" logo left; center links "How it works", "Take the tour"; right a small outline pill "Sign in" and a filled wine pill "Start planning".
2) Centered hero text block in the upper third: large serif headline on two lines "Your AI copilot for the perfect wedding." with the word "perfect" in wine italic; below it one centered line of sans body text "PlusOne finds your vendors, emails them from your own wedding inbox, reads every reply and keeps your budget honest."; below that two pills side by side: filled wine "Start planning" and outline "Take the 1-minute tour".
3) Lower half: a wide, softly shadowed app preview window resting on a pale blush band, showing the PlusOne app working: a left sidebar with "Overview, Vendors, Inbox, Guests"; main area titled "Your vendors" with four rows, each a vendor name, the wedding day, and a small status pill: "Lumen & Lace Photography · Ceremony · Quote received $4,200", "Henna House · Mehndi · Quote received $850", "Saffron Table Catering · Sangeet · Email sent", "Mercer Hall · All days · Booked"; a slim budget bar reading "Committed $22,550 of $60,000"; a tiny grey label "Example" in the window corner. On the right edge of the window, a small floating notification card: "New reply from Henna House — quote added to your budget".
Single focal moment is the app preview; everything else is quiet.
